description: Changing the membrane voltage of non-eye cells in Xenopus embryos induced well-formed ectopic eyes, even far outside the anterior neural field.
limitations: Single species. A calcium-channel pathway transduces the signal, so the voltage acts upstream of known genes.

sources.quote: Manipulating V(mem) of non-eye cells induces well-formed ectopic eyes that are morphologically and histologically similar to endogenous eyes.
